details:
The Edit Image+ node provides advanced image editing and creation powered by the Sharp library (libvips). Use this node when you want to:

- Blur, sharpen, normalize or apply gamma correction
- Add borders, rotate, flip, flop or shear an image
- Resize with smart fit modes (cover, contain, fill, inside, outside)
- Crop a specific region
- Draw shapes (rectangle, circle, line) with fill and stroke
- Render styled text with word-wrap, shadow and alignment
- Composite one image on top of another with 20+ blend modes
- Create blank canvases
- Generate branded images from social media templates (Instagram, YouTube, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, etc.)
- Apply colour effects: grayscale, sepia tone, tint
- Add watermarks with opacity control and gravity positioning
- Make background colours transparent (PNG output)
- Get image metadata (size, format, DPI, channels)
- Chain multiple operations in a single Multi Step node
